Independent audit session for mi-spectral (branch main, at commit c08a18a). You had NO part in
  producing the material you are auditing — treat every claim as suspect until verified against
  artifacts you open yourself. Deliverable: the flag-only audit report + a short verdict memo.
  Do NOT edit manuscript/, literature/, or verification/ (todo/ notes are allowed only if I ask).

  CONTEXT (verify, don't trust): the previous session derived the W2 LRT-differential results
  (D1–D3, todo/024–025) and landed a new section in manuscript/derivation.qmd — "Application: the
  likelihood-ratio differential" (@sec-lrt, Propositions L1–L4) — plus a revised intro LRT bullet,
  a revised @sec-thm "better-conditioned" clause, a roadmap H1-reconciliation caveat, and six new
  Appendix-A source entries (Wilks 1938, Chan & Meng 2022, Chan 2022 AoS, Meng–Rubin 1992,
  Vuong 1989, and a vdV §16.4 addition). It claims: render exit-0; /derivation-audit 0 BLOCKER
  (3 cas-wolfram WARNs = long-known brace-glob false positives — do not churn on those three);
  GPT-5.5 cross-model gate cleared in both modes.

  DO, in order:

  1. /derivation-audit on manuscript/derivation.qmd — full skill protocol, mechanical engine +
     semantic pass. Weight the semantic pass toward the NEW material: do the cited sources
     (literature/<key>.md, read locally, never from memory) actually support what @sec-lrt and the
     new Appendix-A entries attribute to them — especially the Chan (2022 AoS) eq-(1.10)
     weighted-χ² connection, the Vuong non-nested framing, and the Wilks/vdV attributions.

  2. Re-derive the mathematics of Propositions L1–L4 yourself before reading the proofs — at
     minimum: (a) the curvature of Q̄_∞ at θ0 and the metric in which the constrained MI maximizer
     projects; (b) the H0 differential-bias trace formula; (c) whether the naive
     tr(RIV)−tr(RIV_0) difference can understate it (prove or counterexample); (d) the sd order of
     the paired differential at H0 / local / fixed alternatives; (e) the (A)+(C) differential at
     H0. Then compare with the manuscript. Any disagreement is a BLOCKER-level finding.

  3. Reproduce the verification chain: run
     py verification/cas-wolfram/verify_w2_differential.py (must pass all checks), and check the
     manuscript's numbers against the committed caches —
     verification/cache/w2-paired-differential-spotcheck.rds (sd(T_f) 18.4/26.6/36.5 vs sd(D)
     1.58/1.47/1.57 at H0; fixed-arm 12.4/16.8/24.9),
     verification/cache/w2-paired-differential-mu1-cell.rds (2.639±0.113 and 2.701±0.112 vs
     targets B_direct 2.636/2.646 and D_naive 8.47/8.54),
     verification/cache/w1-h1-reconciliation.rds (pooled 2.434±0.258 vs 2.774; sd(T)/√N ≈ 0.75),
     and the W2 null rates 0.042/0.034 cited from verification/cache/W2-prod-amelia.rds.
     Optionally re-run a small slice (e.g. Rscript verification/w2-paired-differential-mu1-cell.R
     200 100 4 1000) — FEW cores, this host segfaults under R contention.

  4. Grade the grading: read verification/cache/layer3-gpt-5.5-w2diff-modeA.md and -modeB.md
     yourself and check whether todo/024's "full agreement / all four claims sustained / zero
     escalation triggers" characterization is honest against the actual response texts and the
     grading key at the bottom of todo/024.

  5. Check the H1 story end-to-end: todo/004 Amendment 2 vs the committed W1-prod-fiml*.rds
     numbers vs the roadmap caveat in derivation.qmd — same numbers, same framing, no
     over-claim ("corroborates" must not have silently become "confirms").

  SCOPE FENCE: the locked theory sections (headline E[T]=½tr(RIV), the +tr/−½tr split, (A)+(C)
  structure/convention, @sec-termA/@sec-combine) were audited in prior sessions — flag only if the
  NEW edits contradict them. Do not start todo/023 (sequel) work. mi-spectral.qmd does not exist;
  the target is derivation.qmd only.

  FINISH: the flag-only report (BLOCKER/WARN/INFO, file:line, evidence, suggested fix), plus a
  3-line verdict: (i) does @sec-lrt's math hold under independent re-derivation, (ii) do the
  numbers reproduce from the committed artifacts, (iii) was the cross-model grading honest.

  Two design notes: step 2 makes the auditor re-derive before reading — that's the strongest independence you can get
  from a same-lineage model, mirroring how the blind routes worked this session; and step 4 audits my grading of the
  GPT-5.5 responses, which is the one link in today's chain that no independent party has yet checked.
